anti_claims_ruled_out: The production interpreter can serve as its own correctness oracle
Primitive determinism alone guarantees composed determinism
why_this_block_exists: Validate that the implemented interpreter realizes the frozen input-total, deterministic, compositional semantics before it is used to generate reference traces.
dataset_split_task: Preregistered property-generated well-formed AST/state/event cases stratified by construct and depth, a hand-audited boundary suite, and all configurations/inputs of declared small finite models.
systems_compared: independently implemented small-step evaluator or directly semantics-derived oracle
setup_details: Run property-based generation with fixed recorded seeds; include branch permutations, merge associativity/commutativity/identity tests, timer/event ties, missing values, ignore/restart, duplicate compatible effects, conservative conflict rejection, zero-time-cycle rejection, and exhaustive small-model successor checks.
success_criterion: Zero unresolved semantic discrepancies, uniqueness violations, or merge-law violations across every completed frozen case; every core construct and predeclared boundary class has nonzero coverage.
minimum_effect_size: Exact zero discrepancy is required for the strong conformance claim; report a one-sided 95% upper confidence bound for unseen discrepancy probability by stratum rather than treating zero observations as proof.
failure_interpretation: Any discrepancy blocks EC-01 until semantics, oracle, or interpreter is corrected and a newly versioned confirmatory run is executed; uncovered strata narrow the claimed core.
compute_budget: Planning cap: one workstation-day after pilot calibration; timeout and generated-case count are frozen before confirmatory execution.
selection_rule: All cases generated from the frozen stratified schema and all hand-audited boundary cases are retained; no post-result filtering except invalid cases under a preregistered validator.
non_vacuity_check: Before the full run, demonstrate at least one intentionally faulty interpreter variant caught by each of permutation, timer-tie, missing-value, reentry, and conflict suites.
complete_outcome_accounting: Log generated, valid, invalid-with-reason, pass, discrepancy, duplicate, skipped, crashed, null, retried, and timed-out cases per seed and stratum.
hidden_information_controls: The production interpreter cannot read oracle results; the independent evaluator is implemented from frozen inference rules and reviewed before production outputs are exposed.
independence_requirements: independent review of boundary expected results
independence_evidence: Record evaluator repository digest, author/reviewer identity role, semantics digest, and signed boundary-case review before execution.
operational_threat_model: Not an operational high-stakes claim; modeled execution only.
operational_harms: No device actuation occurs in this experiment.
predecessor_failures: The old verifier evidence did not establish conformance to a formal executable semantics.

anti_claims_ruled_out: Coverage measured on a favorable corpus generalizes universally
why_this_block_exists: Measure expressive adequacy for the declared target behavior space and expose partial or unsupported behaviors before making a coverage claim.
dataset_split_task: Freeze a reactive-temporal behavior taxonomy, then annotate the provenance-available legacy 382-automation corpus, an independently sourced external automation corpus, and deliberately unsupported negative controls as exact, partial, or unsupported.
systems_compared: frozen Timeline IR core against the predeclared behavior taxonomy
original automation semantics as represented by source artifacts and independent annotation
setup_details: Two technically qualified annotators independently map cases without seeing aggregate results; adjudicate disagreements against frozen semantics. Treat this as technical representability, not a usability or user-intent study.
success_criterion: All predeclared core taxonomy categories have evaluable cases; exact/partial/unsupported rates and uncertainty are reported without exclusions; no deliberately unsupported control is mislabeled exact.
minimum_effect_size: No universal coverage threshold is imposed; the manuscript may claim adequacy only for categories whose preregistered exact-coverage lower 95% bound and failure profile support the final bounded wording.
failure_interpretation: Systematic partial/unsupported results narrow the declared target space; disagreement triggers taxonomy/manual revision and a newly versioned annotation round, not selective removal.
compute_budget: Planning cap: two annotators plus one adjudicator; annotation hours and corpus size fixed after a separate pilot not included in confirmatory estimates.
selection_rule: Apply frozen inclusion rules to complete source lists; retain all eligible cases and every unsupported negative control with provenance.
non_vacuity_check: Pilot set must contain at least one clearly exact, one partial, and one unsupported case and must produce nontrivial independent annotation decisions.
complete_outcome_accounting: Record included, excluded-with-preregistered-reason, exact, partial, unsupported, disagreement, adjudicated, missing-source, invalid, skipped, and withdrawn cases with denominators.
hidden_information_controls: Annotators do not see aggregate coverage or desired thresholds; external corpus selection is completed before scoring.
independence_evidence: Store corpus provenance/digests, blinded label files, timestamps, annotation-manual digest, and adjudication log.
operational_threat_model: Not an operational high-stakes claim; representability only.
operational_harms: No human-subject usability inference and no device deployment.
predecessor_failures: Prior reviewers questioned coverage and generalization beyond the original JoI DSL.

anti_claims_ruled_out: Mutation detection alone demonstrates equivalence checking
Source similarity is a behavioral oracle
Timeout can be treated as agreement
why_this_block_exists: Directly test the checker on exact positive and negative IR-code pairs under identical inputs and observation rules.
dataset_split_task: Frozen gold set with behavior-preserving transformations and independently authored implementations as positives; genuine frozen LLM failures, held-out non-IR-derived faults, and construct-stratified mutants as negatives. Keep development and confirmatory cases separate.
systems_compared: independent gold labels from exact small-model enumeration and manual semantic review
dense replay as a secondary cross-check
setup_details: Run each pair from clean state with identical timed inputs. Freeze labels before checker outcomes. Mutants are generated after corpus split and never used as the only negative evidence. Dense replay is independent corroboration, not a substitute for reachable search.
success_criterion: Zero false accepts and zero false rejects on every completed exact confirmatory gold case, with all incomplete/error cases reported separately and confidence bounds by provenance/fault stratum.
minimum_effect_size: Strong claim requires exact zero observed errors on the frozen exact gold set; statistical upper bounds are reported and no inference is made to arbitrary programs or unbounded histories.
failure_interpretation: Any false accept blocks the safety-relevant strong claim; false rejects require narrowing or comparator/adapter correction; timeouts constrain the completed scope rather than becoming passes.
compute_budget: Planning cap: two workstation-days after E1/E2 gates; case count and per-case timeout frozen using development-only pilots.
selection_rule: Use every frozen confirmatory pair; retain one canonical result per seed plus all technical retries linked to the original run ID.
non_vacuity_check: Before freezing, show one syntax-different positive pair and one temporally deep negative pair for which the checker produces respectively equality and a concrete counterexample.
complete_outcome_accounting: Record TP/TN/false-accept/false-reject, invalid, incomplete-frontier, timeout, adapter error, crash, null, skip, retry, and duplicate with pair provenance.
hidden_information_controls: Lowerer, generated code, adapter, and checker cannot access gold labels, IR verdicts, expected action traces, or mutation operators; gold adjudicators do not see checker output.
independence_requirements: gold labels frozen before checker results
independence_evidence: Store split/provenance digests, authoring records, gold-label signatures, fault-generation code digest, and access-control declaration.
operational_threat_model: No real-device correctness claim; errors concern modeled actions only.
operational_harms: False accepts are treated as the dominant modeled verification risk and reported separately.
predecessor_failures: Old evidence relied heavily on mutants and dense replay and did not establish exhaustive bounded reference-relative equality.

anti_claims_ruled_out: Median runtime alone defines practical exhaustive scope
Synthetic best cases represent pervasive workloads
why_this_block_exists: Characterize the exact Explorer's completion frontier and resource growth rather than claiming unbounded scalability or superiority.
dataset_split_task: Preregistered factorial synthetic generator varying state variables/domains, sensors/events, timers, parallel rules, AST depth, and horizon, plus representative real-workload anchors selected from E2 before outcomes.
systems_compared: exact canonical-state BFS when complete product snapshots are available
bounded history-tree fallback when code-state merging is not justified
setup_details: Generate multiple structurally distinct instances per factorial cell, randomize measured run order, warm up separately, isolate process state, retain target-edge-hardware results as a subcondition if available, and report state-space growth and resource frontier without baseline-superiority wording.
success_criterion: Produce a reproducible completed/incomplete frontier over every preregistered factor cell, with no missing timeout/error outcomes and at least one representative E2 workload anchor completed or explicitly bounded.
minimum_effect_size: No speedup threshold is claimed; the decisive output is the measured capacity region and uncertainty/tail cost on fixed hardware under declared limits.
failure_interpretation: Early resource exhaustion narrows the practical verification envelope but does not invalidate semantic determinism; irregular results trigger profiler-led sensitivity runs without deleting original outcomes.
compute_budget: Planning cap: three workstation-days plus an optional already-available edge device subcondition inside E4; stop per run at the frozen time/memory limits.
selection_rule: Execute every frozen factorial cell and selected real anchor; use preregistered technical retry rules only, retaining parent outcomes.
non_vacuity_check: Pilot must show at least one small completed cell and one larger cell with materially greater state/history count so the sweep can expose a frontier.
complete_outcome_accounting: Record success, fixpoint-complete, horizon-complete, resource-incomplete, timeout, OOM, adapter error, invalid generation, crash, skip, null, and retry per cell/seed.
hidden_information_controls: Factor grid and real anchors are frozen before aggregate performance is inspected; no cell is removed for poor performance.
independence_evidence: Store container/host manifests, factor-grid digest, workload provenance, raw process metrics, and run-order log.
operational_threat_model: Resource characterization only; no physical-device outcome claim.
operational_harms: Edge execution, if used, is a performance subcondition and does not actuate devices.
predecessor_failures: The old median replay-gate latency did not characterize reachable-state growth or incomplete frontiers.
